**<:MemberLeave:1087453384858157149> Leave Messages**

> `{0}leave channel set <#channel>`
> `{0}leave channel remove`
> `{0}leave message <message>`
> `{0}leave picture set <picture>`
> `{0}leave picture remove`
> `{0}leave picture show`

> Variables for leave message are `{{user_mention}}`, `{{user_name}}`, `{{user_discriminator}}`, `{{guild_name}}`, `{{guild_membercount}}`
> You can create a leave message with multiple lines using `\n`
> To completely remove the leave message, add `_ _` as the message
